description: Blazor WebAssembly client for MentorAgent. Install in your Blazor WASM / Blazor Auto client project. Connects to a MentorAgent.Server hub via SignalR and provides the same ChatWidget experience as Blazor Server.
releaseNotes:
1.0.0-preview.4

		=== Provider-hosted tools ===================================================
		- NEW — MentorAgentBlazorOptions.ShowHostedToolsStatus + HostedTools mirror the server configuration so the widget header can list the provider-hosted tools (web search, code interpreter, file search, image generation, remote MCP). Display only — the tools are configured and executed on the MentorAgent.Server project.
		- NEW — the server now publishes its active hosted-tool set on connect and the widget prefers it over the local option, so the badge stops drifting from what the server actually enabled. Requires MentorAgent.Server 1.0.0-preview.4; a mismatched pair simply falls back to the local option.

		=== Multimodal image input =================================================
		- NEW — the WASM widget can attach images to a message (file upload, clipboard paste, drag & drop, remote URL) and they travel to the server over the hub as SendMessage(text, attachments). Enable with MentorAgentBlazorOptions.EnableImageInput (+ MaxImageBytes / MaxImagesPerMessage / AllowedImageTypes, which mirror the server options for instant client-side feedback; the server is what actually enforces them). WasmMentorOrchestrator / MentorHubClient gained the SendMessageAsync(text, attachments) overload. Requires EnableImageInput and a vision-capable model on the server project.
		- Fix — sending a real photo silently did nothing: the hub connection was dropped because the base64 payload exceeded SignalR's 32 KB default message size. Fixed server-side; requires MentorAgent.Server 1.0.0-preview.4. A failed send is now also reported in the chat instead of being swallowed.
		- Fix — pasting a screenshot with Ctrl+V was silently ignored unless the caret was already in the text box; oversized screenshots are now downscaled in the browser instead of being refused. See the MentorAgent.Abstractions notes.

		=== Turn lifecycle =========================================================
		- Fix (Stop button) — pressing Stop in a WASM client did nothing and the request kept streaming to the end. WasmMentorOrchestrator.CancelCurrentRequest now posts to /mentor/cancel over HTTP instead of invoking the CancelRequest hub method, which SignalR could not dispatch while SendMessage was streaming on the same connection. Requires MentorAgent.Server 1.0.0-preview.4 for the new endpoint.

		=== Human-in-the-loop approval ==============================================
		- Note — the WASM approval path is unchanged and works with either server-side HITL mode. The widget receives the same ConfirmationRequired event and replies over the same POST /mentor/approve endpoint, so switching the server to the Agent Framework's native approval flow needs no client change.
title: MentorAgent.Blazor
